title: Best Direct Response Agencies for Meta Video Ads (2026)
summary: Compare seven direct response agencies for Facebook and Instagram by job, Meta scope, video creative and published pricing. Checked October 26, 2026.
body_markdown:
## Which agencies run full-funnel DTC media with creative production?


### MuteSix


As of October 2026,[MuteSix](https://mutesix.com/) lists paid social (Instagram, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Pinterest), paid search, retail media, programmatic, marketing science and lifecycle marketing, plus creative services under a Performance Studio heading (design, story, content and production). Its Facebook page names SMS and email under lifecycle marketing and describes creative from a network of creators and influencers, an in-house StudioSix team and iterative testing. Its[production page](https://mutesix.com/services/bespoke-production/) covers live action, animation, iPhone-shot social content and post-production, with a production-only package for brands that buy media elsewhere. Pricing is not published.


**Best for** DTC brands that want Meta run inside a wider media plan, with production in-house. Ask for production and media management as separate lines.


### Pilothouse


As of October 2026,[Pilothouse](https://pilothouse.co/) , based in Victoria, British Columbia, describes itself as a full-funnel performance marketing agency built for established, ambitious DTC ecommerce brands. Its Meta page lists static, motion and UGC concepts, Advantage+ shopping, sales and awareness campaigns, hook, story and offer testing across feeds, Reels and Stories, landing page design and creative-level reporting. Pricing is not published; its homepage says engagements combine monthly retainers, performance-based incentives and custom project scopes, with onboarding typically starting within 5 to 10 business days of signing.


**Best for** established DTC brands that want Meta media, creative testing and landing pages handled together.


## Which agencies focus on Facebook and Instagram campaign management?


### Voy Media


As of October 2026,[Voy Media](https://voymedia.com/) says it focuses on direct response and customer acquisition in ecommerce, lead generation and mobile. Its direct response page lists full-service Facebook and Instagram ads with retargeting, custom audiences and dynamic product ads, a dedicated account manager and lead strategist, and a creative studio covering video production and editing, UGC and photography. Its[pricing page](https://voymedia.com/pricing/) publishes no figures and says packages are based on total ad spend, optimizations and growth.


**Best for** brands that want Facebook and Instagram direct response, including lead generation and mobile, with creative made in-house.


### KlientBoost


As of October 2026, KlientBoost's Facebook ads page offers five ways to work: ongoing management, a one-time audit, a one-time setup, consulting, and a performance option it calls a revenue partnership. It names ecommerce, SaaS and lead-generation campaigns and says it handles photo, video and animated ad formats. Its FAQ says fees are sometimes a percentage of ad spend and sometimes a flat fee, that it works with clients spending from as little as $5,000 a month on advertising, and that your Facebook page, Instagram page and Business Manager always remain yours. Fee levels and contract length are not published.


**Best for** teams that want an audit, a one-time setup or a performance-based arrangement rather than only full management.


### Disruptive Advertising


As of October 2026, Disruptive Advertising's social advertising page covers Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and X in three tiers: a free audit, a "do it with us" tier it prices at "a couple thousand dollars," and a "done for you" tier covering strategy, budget management, tracking and creative optimization. It says that if it cannot get results in 90 days, you don't pay. Its[homepage](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/) says the guarantee applies to "qualifying brands," without defining them, and says there are no long-term contracts. The social page does not define what counts as results, and it does not describe video production.


**Best for** teams that want to start with an audit or shared work before handing over the account. Ask for the guarantee's terms in writing.


## Who makes direct-response video ads at volume for Meta?


Some buyers already have a media buyer and need only the ads. Most agencies above describe creative work alongside media buying, and MuteSix offers a production-only package for brands that buy media elsewhere. Knowlify, our top pick above, also offers creative-only delivery for teams with their own media buyer. Specialist performance creative studios are another route: our[performance creative agency guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/performance-creative-agency) explains how to evaluate one, and our[TubeScience alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/tubescience-alternatives) compares studios built around video.


## What does a direct response agency cost?


Most of the agencies in this guide quote privately. These are the only figures they publish, checked October 26, 2026:


Agency Published figure What it refers to


Knowlify (our top pick) Custom quote Scoped on a 30-minute call


Darkroom From $1,500 a month Paid media retainer, plus a percentage of media, depending on channels


Disruptive Advertising "A couple thousand dollars" The "do it with us" paid social tier


KlientBoost From $5,000 a month The client ad budgets it works with, not its fee


Common Thread Collective $100K+ a month on Meta The spend level its Meta page invites, not a stated minimum


MuteSix, Pilothouse, Voy Media Not published Quote on request


Published fee structures include a retainer plus a percentage of media (Darkroom), a percentage of spend or flat fee (KlientBoost), and performance-based options (Pilothouse's incentives and KlientBoost's revenue partnership). Media spend is paid to Meta on top. Send every finalist the same brief and ask for management, creative production and setup as separate lines; our[Facebook ad agency pricing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-ad-agency-pricing) has a worksheet.


## What should you ask a direct response agency before signing?


- **Account ownership.** Will campaigns run in your own Meta ad account? Knowlify's end-to-end service runs campaigns in yours, and KlientBoost says your Facebook page, Instagram page and Business Manager always remain yours; ask every finalist to put it in writing.
- **Measurement.** Who sets up and maintains the Meta Pixel and the Conversions API, and which events will be sent to Meta?
- **Creative volume.** How many new concepts and how many variations will you get each month, in which formats, and how fast? Our[ad creative testing framework](https://knowlify.com/articles/ad-creative-testing) shows how to plan each test.
- **Feedback loop.** If the agency makes ads but does not run them, who reads the results and briefs the next batch?
- **Guarantees and incentives.** For any guarantee or performance fee, ask how results are defined, which brands qualify and how billing works.
- **Commitment.** Ask for the contract length, the notice period and what you keep if you leave.


## Key takeaways


- Our top pick is Knowlify for brands that need AI video ads at volume, with optional Meta campaign management; it does not supply real people on camera or channels beyond Meta.
- Choose a direct response agency by the job: profit-led Meta buying at high spend, full-funnel DTC media, focused Facebook and Instagram management, or a steady supply of video ads.
- Meta's Advantage+ automates audience, placements and budget, so ask every agency how much new creative it delivers and how it tests it.
- Few agencies publish prices, so compare written quotes for the same scope.
- Confirm account ownership, Pixel and Conversions API setup, and any guarantee terms in writing.


## FAQ


### What is a direct response agency?


An agency that runs ads asking for an immediate, measurable action, such as a purchase, lead or app install, and manages them by cost per result. On Facebook and Instagram, that means media buying, tracking with the Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and a steady flow of new ads to test.


### Which direct response agencies work on Facebook and Instagram?


Knowlify, our top pick, makes AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with optional campaign management. As of October 2026, the seven other agencies here also publish Meta services: Common Thread Collective, Darkroom, MuteSix, Pilothouse, Voy Media, KlientBoost and Disruptive Advertising.


### Who makes direct-response video ads?


Knowlify, our top pick, makes about 25 AI video ads a week, with Meta campaign management or creative-only. As of October 2026, CTC, Darkroom, MuteSix, Pilothouse, Voy Media and KlientBoost describe creative work alongside media buying, and MuteSix sells production on its own.


### How much does a direct response agency cost?


Most quote privately. As of October 2026, Darkroom's paid media pricing starts at $1,500 a month plus a percentage of media, and Disruptive Advertising prices its shared-work tier at a couple thousand dollars. KlientBoost works with ad budgets from $5,000 a month. Media spend is always separate.


### Is Knowlify a direct response agency?


Yes, for Facebook and Instagram, and it is our top pick. Knowlify is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram that can manage campaigns in your own Meta ad account or deliver creative only. Its UGC-style ads use AI presenters, so choose a creator-led agency if you need real people on camera.
